questions.question: Which of these are primary colors in the traditional RYB model?
questions.rationale: The traditional RYB model uses red, yellow and blue. Green is a secondary color made by mixing blue and yellow.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.rationale: Canberra was purpose-built as the capital as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.question: Which of the following are prime numbers?
questions.rationale: 2, 11 and 17 have no divisors other than 1 and themselves. 9 = 3x3 and 15 = 3x5.

questions.question: Which HTML tag is used for the largest heading?
questions.rationale: <h1> is the top-level heading. <h6> is the smallest, and <head> and <header> are not headings.

questions.question: Which of these planets have rings?
questions.rationale: Saturn's rings are the most famous, but Jupiter, Uranus and Neptune all have ring systems too. Mars has none.

questions.question: Which data structure uses first-in, first-out (FIFO) ordering?
questions.rationale: A queue removes the oldest item first. A stack is last-in, first-out.

questions.question: Which of these are JavaScript frameworks or libraries?
questions.rationale: React and Vue are JavaScript UI libraries. Django is a Python framework and Rails is a Ruby framework.

questions.question: What is the boiling point of water at sea level in degrees Celsius?
questions.rationale: Water boils at 100 C (212 F) at standard atmospheric pressure. It boils at lower temperatures at altitude.
